videos.t: why you shouldn't use injection molded gears
videos.desc:
Why you shouldn't use injection molded gears, especially when your worm rod is made of metal and overcurrent in motors is a thing. 

These blue helical gears were paired with a soft metal worm rod in the gearboxes used for an aerospace project at work. Motor overcurrent happened, the system pushed itself too far (overload), melting into the plastic on some areas, cracking some of the teeth, and digging into the gear. 

The grease in the gearbox was also full of plastic shavings. What a mess. This happened to four gears...

Funny story: Our department was asked to 3D model and print these gears
